content:
Emma: quick sync - need to finalize rerank score encoding + routing sensitivity before quota/dashboard rollout tomorrow. console buckets spiked in yesterday's canary, noticed by infra alerts. anyone have immediate theories?
Raj: saw the alert. runtime returns float32 scores but the telemetry collector packs them to int16 to save bandwidth. the packing changes bucket boundaries in the dashboard.
Miguel: packing was intentional for throughput. we trade precision for payload size. didn't think it would break console buckets this badly.
Sara: product note: console and SLA-alerts assume score continuity. quantization causes alerts to flip-flop; customers will see noisy regressions. can we normalize in the console for now?
Kevin: quota calc uses score_units = ceil(score * weight). quantization means throttle decisions bounce. that's the bigger risk.
Emma: options: (A) keep int16 packed but publish stable bucket mapping & decoder; (B) stop packing and emit float32 end-to-end; (C) emit histogram summaries instead of per-candidate scores. thoughts?
Raj: (A) lowest infra work but brittle across versions and fragile when models evolve. (B) clean semantics, cost ~10-15% bandwidth on rerank path. (C) good for dashboards but loses candidate-level info for debugging.
Miguel: bandwidth estimate for (B) is ~12% p95. we could mitigate via gzip and trace sampling for heavy tenants.
Sara: rollout UX: per-tenant opt-in to new encoding + console toggle to compare legacy vs normalized buckets. product wants per-model distribution preview in rollout flow.
Emma: prefer per-model and per-tenant toggles. model-specific score distributions vary a lot, routing sensitivity should be model-scoped.
Raj: model-scoped sensitivity implies router needs model_id + distribution signature in requests -> increases router metadata and cache key cardinality.
Kevin: the extra complexity is acceptable if it stabilizes SLA behavior. ops asks for a global fallback mapping if model signature is missing.
Miguel: implementation plan: collector emits both fields during transition: score_float and score_q16. score_q16 = int16(round(score_float * 32767)). telemetry pipeline passes both; console gets a toggle. after 2 weeks flip default to float.
Emma: proposed compatibility proto for the canary:
```
message RerankScoreEvent {
  string model_id = 1;
  float score_float = 2; // new canonical field
  int32 score_q16 = 3;  // legacy packed field (optional)
  map<string,string> meta = 4;
}
```
Raj: sounds good. router logic: prefer score_float when present, decode score_q16 otherwise. I'll add unit tests for decode parity.
Sara: console UX: add "Use legacy score encoding" toggle with tooltip about jitter and a timestamp showing when model started emitting float. include per-model distribution preview in rollout modal.
Kevin: gating: canary 5% tenants, compare throttle delta. SLO: no >2% change in 95th throttle rate, no >1% uptick in on-call alerts.
Emma: ops, @deploy-bot status?
deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated: rerank-collector/v2 on cluster rerank-canary-2 (pods: 3). collector.mem < 65%, p50 latency +2ms.
Miguel: pushing collector PR with dual-field emit behind feature flag. enabling only for canary tenants initially.
Raj: router PR: fallback decode for score_q16, prefer score_float. adding integration test against sampled canary traces.
Sara: product will implement console toggle + distribution preview. drafting tooltip copy and UX notes now.
Kevin: I'll create a dashboard that shows legacy vs float buckets side-by-side and the throttle delta metric. will schedule alert if delta > 1.5%.
Emma: action items: Miguel -> collector dual-field canary; Raj -> router fallback + tests; Kevin -> SLO checks, side-by-side dashboard; Sara -> console toggle + rollout copy; Emma -> send rollout plan and announce on platform slack.
Miguel: canary and initial telemetry comparison in ~48h. pushing PR now.
Emma: thanks all. we'll reconvene after canary metrics. :thumbsup:
